q2_gaps: object topicalization / fronting ("The last years of his life he spent in France") — the instruction set marks information structure only for focus particles and it-/pseudo-clefts, so a fronted object has no prescribed marking; here nothing truth-conditional is lost
notes: The fronted object is assigned its role by grammatical function, correctly, and the group/PartOf treatment of "the last years of his life" follows the definite-plural and genitive rules. The distribution rule at index 5 hands "last" to every member of the group, which is the prescribed treatment for a descriptive modifier on a plural but reads oddly for an ordinal-like adjective that can hold of only one member at a time.
